brand.name: Harrewijn Data
brand.tagline: Data consulting for better decisions, better processes and sustainable change.

hero.eyebrow: Data Strategy · Process Improvement · Data Platforms
hero.title: Better decisions start with better data and better processes.
hero.intro: Harrewijn Data helps organisations work smarter with data. Clearer decisions, more efficient processes and solutions the organisation can manage itself.

services_intro.title: From organisational challenge to a solution that works.

services.title: Data strategy & architecture
services.text: I help organisations decide where they want to go with data and what is needed to get there. Together we turn priorities, ownership and architecture into a clear and realistic direction.

services.title: Data quality & governance
services.text: Reliable data starts with clear agreements. I help define ownership, standards and controls so people know which data they can trust and who is responsible for what.

services.title: Process improvement & decision support
services.text: Many processes still rely on manual work, disconnected files or repeated checks. I map the process and identify where data, automation or AI can make the work simpler, faster and more reliable.

services.title: Data platforms
services.text: When a new or improved data platform is needed, I can also lead the implementation. The technology supports the way the organisation wants to work, rather than becoming the goal in itself.

proof.title: Advice that also works in practice.
proof.text: I help organisations choose a direction and make it work — from stakeholder alignment and process improvement to governance and implementation.

featured_cases.title: A governed Fabric platform for reliable operational insight
featured_cases.text: Designed and implemented a Microsoft Fabric data platform with dimensional modelling, row-level security, automated data quality checks, scorecard reporting and end-user enablement.
featured_cases.result: Four reporting domains — Care, HR, Finance and Quality — brought onto one governed platform, including management reporting based on the Balanced Scorecard.

featured_cases.title: One data foundation across seven government partners
featured_cases.text: Led the redesign of a centralised Fabric data warehouse, aligning platform choices with public-sector standards, governance requirements and a roadmap toward Purview.
featured_cases.result: Requirements from multiple autonomous public-sector partners were harmonised into one functional design and one technical direction.

featured_cases.title: From source systems to governed reporting in Fabric
featured_cases.text: Delivered an end-to-end data warehouse and Power BI implementation with metadata-driven pipelines, medallion architecture, governance and operational monitoring.
featured_cases.result: Multiple business domains and reports were consolidated onto one central reusable data model with live data-quality monitoring.

approach.title: Understand the organisation first. Then improve the solution.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: Map the business question, current process, stakeholders, pain points and constraints before choosing a solution.

steps.title: Align
steps.text: Turn different interests and requirements into one shared direction, clear priorities and workable design principles.

steps.title: Improve
steps.text: Redesign the process and supporting data solution in short iterations, with visible outcomes and measurable progress.

steps.title: Embed
steps.text: Transfer knowledge, document ownership and support adoption so the new way of working lasts after the project.

about.title: Jonan Harrewijn
about.lead: Senior Data Architect and Business Analyst focused on better decisions, better processes and practical change.
about.text: My work usually starts with people and processes, not technology. I bring different interests together, make complex questions concrete and help organisations arrive at a practical way forward. Because I also understand the technical delivery, the advice stays realistic and implementable.
about.expertise_text: Experience across business analysis, process improvement, stakeholder management, data strategy, governance, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.

cta.title: Let’s improve the way your organisation works with data.
cta.text: Whether the challenge is inefficient processes, unclear ownership, fragmented reporting or a platform that no longer fits the organisation, I can help structure the problem, align the people involved and turn it into a workable next step.

proof_metrics.label: production data platform scale
